## Description {#details}

Empty base struct for all operator types.

The <code>op</code> struct serves as a common base for all operator and value wrapper types used in the µTest++ framework&#39;s type traits and metaprogramming utilities. It provides a unified type hierarchy, enabling compile-time detection and generic handling of operator-like types within the framework.

This struct is intended for internal use as a base for integral constants, floating point constants, and other value wrappers, supporting advanced template metaprogramming and type introspection.
